surfaces.scratch_title: replace only the title region inside the existing Selected Scratch Context surface with a labelled Scratch title field
surfaces.breakdown_content: replace only the active source row content region with a labelled Breakdown content field in the same sorted row
surfaces.shared_structure: field, persistent inline status, actions, then comparison or recovery content when required
surfaces.expansion: source surface may grow vertically but keeps width, identity, and theme family

state_binding.lifetime: mounted Inbox page only; no durable draft, resolver, or recovery persistence

base_interaction.entry: focus the source field with caret at end and do not select all automatically
base_interaction.save: conditional CAS Save of the current non-empty draft
base_interaction.valid_blur: Save unless blur is caused by theme or locale activation or occurs during IME composition
base_interaction.cancel_or_escape: restore current authoritative truth and return to surviving source Edit

validation.actions: Save disabled; Cancel enabled; error linked to field

saving.actions: mutation and dismissal locked; Stay here only when one pending intent exists

offline.copy: Offline. Your draft is still here.
offline.actions: Retry save disabled until reconnect; Cancel enabled; no automatic save

not_applied.copy: Not saved. Your draft is still here.

reconciling.copy: Checking whether your changes were saved…
reconciling.actions: mutation and dismissal locked; Stay here only when one pending intent exists

invalidated.heading: Draft not saved
invalidated.scratch_reason: This Scratch is no longer editable.
invalidated.row_reason: This breakdown is no longer editable.
invalidated.description: Review or copy your draft before closing.

conditional_authority.use_mine: start a new conditional Save against only the latest version the user acknowledged; never last-write-wins
conditional_authority.use_latest: perform no write, adopt current authoritative truth, close, and return to surviving Edit
conditional_authority.remote_refresh_during_conflict: update only Latest version in place; preserve draft, one resolver, composition, and focus
conditional_authority.staged_or_invalid_source: Save and Use mine are unavailable and source truth is never resurrected

copy_and_status.copy_behavior: copy full untruncated draft without state or focus change
copy_and_status.announcements: polite atomic state changes only; never announce each keystroke

pending_intent.cancel_semantics: cancel only the one pending intent, never the in-flight Save or draft
pending_intent.terminal_semantics: applied Save runs the still-pending intent once; every non-success runs none

focus.saving_reconciling: keep focused field mounted and read-only
focus.saved_or_cancelled: return to surviving source Edit unless a pending intent owns the next destination
focus.invalidated_row: next visible row, then Add input

motion_and_reduced_motion.ordinary: static immediate state changes with no spinner rotation, pulse, bounce, blink, scale, or layout-transition animation
motion_and_reduced_motion.reduced: identical surface, copy, action hierarchy, focus, and lifecycle

theme_mapping.griddo: in-place semantic fields, technical status rules, labelled comparison blocks, and canonical actions
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: same-sheet ruled fields, paper status annotations, and labelled paper comparison/recovery sections
theme_mapping.neumorphism: inset fields and comparison wells inside existing Context or row depth with raised actions
theme_mapping.claymorphism: shape-preserving inset text channels, restrained seams, and raised actions within source silhouettes
theme_mapping.origami: inline field, comparison, and recovery folds inside the same source paper geometry
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven editable record lines and static status/diff blocks with no blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-place 1-bit fields, hard status/comparison panes, and default-button hierarchy without new windows
theme_mapping.graphite: editorial fields, strengthened status rules, and labelled manuscript comparison/recovery blocks
